Package chess.model

Class Move

java.lang.Object
chess.model.Move
public final class Move extends Object
One chess move: which piece moved, where from and to, what it captured, and what kind of move it was.

Moves are immutable. In Phase 1 the move history was a list of text; a Move object can also be read back by the program, which en passant (it needs the previous move), the computer opponent and the logger rely on.

    • toDescription

      public String toDescription()
      Describes the move in the same style as the Phase 1 move history, such as "White pawn E2 - E4", "White knight F3 x E5" or "White pawn A7 - A8 =Q". The rules added in Phase 2 follow the same style: "White castles kingside", "... en passant", and "check" or "checkmate" at the end.
      Returns:
      a readable description of the move
